name: laporan_aktivitas_psak109
query:
WITH
mv AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(cc.code,'ZZZZZ') AS dana_code, COALESCE(cc.name,'(Tanpa Dana)') AS dana,
    CASE WHEN kl.noklasifikasi IN (4,8) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS section_urut,
    CASE WHEN kl.noklasifikasi IN (4,8) THEN 'Penghasilan' ELSE 'Beban' END AS section,
    sk.nosubklasifikasi AS subklas_urut, sk.namasubklasifikasi AS subklas,
    k.code AS akun_kode, k.nama AS akun_nama,
    (CASE WHEN kl.noklasifikasi IN (4,8) THEN SUM(G1.kredit - G1.debit)
          ELSE SUM(G1.debit - G1.kredit) END)::numeric(18,2) AS nilai
  FROM (
    SELECT g.id AS gid, g.tanggal::date AS d, g.department_id AS department_id,
           g.project_id AS project_id, jv.account_id AS account_id,
           jv.cost_code_id AS cost_code_id, jv.debit AS debit, jv.kredit AS kredit
    FROM g_jurnal g JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id
    WHERE g.status = 'approved'
  ) G1
  LEFT JOIN cost_codes cc ON cc.id = G1.cost_code_id
  JOIN kiraan     k  ON k.id  = G1.account_id
  JOIN subklas    sk ON sk.id = k.subclassification_id
  JOIN klas       kl ON kl.id = sk.classification_id
  WHERE kl.noklasifikasi IN (4,5,6,7,8,9) {andWhere}
  GROUP BY COALESCE(cc.code,'ZZZZZ'), COALESCE(cc.name,'(Tanpa Dana)'),
           kl.noklasifikasi,
           sk.nosubklasifikasi, sk.namasubklasifikasi, k.code, k.nama
  HAVING (CASE WHEN kl.noklasifikasi IN (4,8) THEN SUM(G1.kredit - G1.debit)
               ELSE SUM(G1.debit - G1.kredit) END) <> 0
),
akhir AS (
  -- Net aset akhir per dana = akumulasi (penerimaan - penyaluran) SELURUH riwayat (TANPA filter periode).
  -- Saldo Awal dihitung di layer laporan = saldo_akhir_dana - surplus periode.
  -- Catatan: akurat bila tanggal-akhir filter >= tanggal data terakhir (laporan setahun/penuh).
  SELECT COALESCE(cc.code,'ZZZZZ') AS dana_code, SUM(jv.kredit - jv.debit)::numeric(18,2) AS saldo_akhir_dana
  FROM g_jurnal g
  JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id
  LEFT JOIN cost_codes cc ON cc.id = jv.cost_code_id
  JOIN kiraan     k  ON k.id  = jv.account_id
  JOIN subklas    sk ON sk.id = k.subclassification_id
  JOIN klas       kl ON kl.id = sk.classification_id
  WHERE g.status = 'approved' AND kl.noklasifikasi IN (4,5,6,7,8,9)
  GROUP BY COALESCE(cc.code,'ZZZZZ')
)
SELECT mv.dana_code, mv.dana, mv.section_urut, mv.section, mv.subklas_urut, mv.subklas,
       mv.akun_kode, mv.akun_nama, mv.nilai,
       COALESCE(ak.saldo_akhir_dana, 0)::numeric(18,2) AS saldo_akhir_dana
FROM mv
LEFT JOIN akhir ak ON ak.dana_code = mv.dana_code
ORDER BY mv.dana_code, mv.section_urut, mv.subklas_urut, mv.akun_kode {andOrder} {limit}

  JOIN klas       kl ON kl.id = sk.classification_id
